query: Virgin Galactic (SPCE) financing, capital raise, cash position and going concern status in 2026. Has the company raised significant capital or secured funding in Q2 2026 (April-June 2026)? What is their current cash runway?
answer:
I've completed the research on Virgin Galactic's (SPCE) financing and cash position in 2026. Here's the summary of key findings:

**Going concern & cash position:** Virgin Galactic filed an **explicit going-concern warning** in its Q1 2026 10-Q (May 14, 2026), with management stating substantial doubt about its ability to continue operations for 12 months. It held **$251M in cash/securities as of March 31, 2026** (down from $338M at YE2025).

**Q2 2026 capital raise:** The company did **NOT announce a large transformational raise**. Its Q2 financing was primarily **~$52M gross via its ATM equity program in April 2026**, plus a small stock-settled redemption of $10M of 2028 notes (announced April 30). It had ~$87M remaining on its $300M ATM program and filed a new $40.21M S-3 shelf on May 14. June 2026 "new strategic investor" chatter during the meme rally was **not confirmed by filings**.

**Cash runway:** With ~$251M plus ~$52M April proceeds against ~$90M/quarter burn (Q2 guided to $(87)M–$(92)M FCF), the implied runway is **roughly 3–4 quarters (into ~mid-2027)** before further financing — matching management's own going-concern conclusion. The company is dependent on both continued ATM/capital-markets access and its targeted Q4 2026 commercial flight revenue start.

**Important timing note:** Q2 2026 earnings (period ended June 30) had **not yet been reported** as of July 16, 2026 (expected early-to-mid August), so the latest hard financials are Q1 2026.

key_facts: Q1 2026 10-Q (filed May 14, 2026) contains an EXPLICIT going-concern warning under ASC 205-40; management stated substantial doubt about ability to continue as a going concern for 12 months.
Cash, cash equivalents & marketable securities were $251M as of March 31, 2026 (incl. ~$31M restricted), down from $338M at Dec 31, 2025.
Q2 2026 capital raise activity: ~$52M gross raised via ATM equity program in April 2026 (not in the $251M March 31 balance); ~$87M remained on the $300M ATM program as of May 14.
No large/transformational strategic capital raise has been announced; June 2026 'new strategic investor' reports were unconfirmed by official filings.
Q1 2026 free cash flow was $(93.3)M; Q2 2026 FCF guided to $(87)M to $(92)M — roughly $90M/quarter burn.
Management concluded its mitigation plans (ATM equity, more financing, Q4 2026 commercial service, stock-settled debt redemptions) do NOT alleviate the going-concern doubt.
Implied cash runway ~3-4 quarters (into roughly mid-2027) before additional financing, dependent on capital-markets access and Q4 2026 commercial revenue start.
On April 30, 2026, VG offered to redeem $10M of 2028 first-lien notes via common stock issuance (ahead of schedule); ~$202M would remain on first-lien notes due Dec 2028.
New Form S-3 shelf registered $40.21M for ATM offerings, filed May 14, 2026.
Heavy dilution: weighted average shares rose from 35.4M (Q1 2025) to 79.5M (Q1 2026).
Q2 2026 earnings (period ended June 30, 2026) had NOT been reported as of July 16, 2026 (expected early-to-mid August).
SPCE closed at $2.71 on July 15, 2026 (market cap ~$348M); 52-week range $2.13-$8.90; meme-driven peak of $7.52 on June 1, 2026.
Flight test targeted Q3 2026, first commercial spaceflight targeted Q4 2026; ~650 founding astronaut reservations (~$186M backlog), new tickets at $750,000.
